Penny

Penny is a cute, sassy girl who loves pets but also loves her independence—and she'll let you know with a few little nibbles!

She is good with both cats and dogs and would do well as an indoor or indoor/outdoor cat. Penny loves playing with small shaker toys and long, flowy toys that she can chase.

She is up to date on her vaccines, has been dewormed, and is spayed. She has experience eating both dry and wet food.

🐱 Good with cats · 🐶 Good with dogs · 🎾 Playful · 💕 Independent · ✨ Sassy

Baby

Baby is another sassy girl with lots to say! She is talkative, playful, and loves playing with her siblings, so having another friendly cat or kitten to keep her company would be great for her.

She loves to explore outside, but since she is still a kitten, I would recommend keeping her indoors for now while she grows.

Baby is up to date on her vaccines, has been dewormed, and is spayed.

Chunk

Chunk is my cuddly girl who loves pets and playing with her toys! She especially loves her jiggle ball and long, flowy toys that she can chase.

She is curious and loves to follow you around and see what you're up to. She also enjoys playing with her siblings, so having another friendly cat or kitten as a companion would be great for her.

Chunk loves wet food and is always happy when it's mealtime!

She likes exploring outside, but since she is still a kitten, I would recommend keeping her indoors for now while she grows.

💕 Cuddly · 🐱 Good with cats · 🎾 Playful · 👀 Curious · 🍽️ Loves wet food · 🏠 Indoor kitten

About the Foster

I foster cats and kittens in the San Antonio area through the San Antonio Feral Cat Coalition, helping cats get the care, socialization, and safe temporary home they need while they wait for their forever families.

After these kittens find their homes, I plan to continue fostering—including adult cats who may need a little extra time and attention.

Interested in Adopting?

Adoptions are handled through the San Antonio Feral Cat Coalition. Visit their official adoptable-cats page to see available cats and start the adoption process.
